title: Not All Directions Are Flat: Decomposed-Gradient Flatness for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2611.28802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many applications of novel view synthesis, such as augmented reality and robotics, can afford only a few input views, since dense capture is costly. With such sparse views, however, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) overfits the training views and degrades at unseen viewpoints. Among the approaches to this problem, flat-minima optimization treats the Gaussians as trainable parameters and steers training toward flat minima, which generalize better, by perturbing the Gaussians with random noise or along the training gradient. However, these perturbations ignore their direction relative to the other training views. Interestingly, we find that the direction of the perturbation determines whether it improves generalization. Specifically, we decompose the gradient of each training view into a component parallel to the average gradient of all views, on which the views agree, and an orthogonal component, on which they disagree. translated_title: 并非所有方向都是平坦的：面向稀疏视角3D高斯泼溅的分解梯度平坦度
translated_abstract: 许多新视角合成的应用（如增强现实和机器人技术）由于密集采集成本高昂，只能提供少量输入视角。然而，在这种稀疏视角条件下，3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）会过拟合训练视角，并在未见过的新视角上性能退化。在解决该问题的诸多方法中，平坦极小值优化将高斯视为可训练参数，通过用随机噪声或沿训练梯度方向对高斯施加扰动，引导训练走向泛化性能更好的平坦极小值。然而，这些扰动忽略了其相对于其他训练视角的方向。有趣的是，我们发现扰动的方向决定了它能否改善泛化。具体而言，我们将每个训练视角的梯度分解为一个与所有视角平均梯度平行的分量（各视角在此方向上一致）和一个正交的分量（各视角在此方向上存在分歧）。沿（该分量方向进行扰动……）——原文摘要在此处截断。
tldr: 该论文发现扰动的方向决定了稀疏视角下3D高斯泼溅的泛化效果，并提出将各训练视角梯度分解为视角间一致的平行分量与存在分歧的正交分量的“分解梯度平坦度”方法，以引导训练走向真正泛化的平坦极小值。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the direction of perturbation determines generalization in sparse-view 3DGS, and proposes decomposed-gradient flatness, splitting each view's gradient into a parallel component where views agree and an orthogonal component where they disagree, to steer training toward truly generalizable flat minima.
